facts.fact: BMZ reports the Rwandan government launched the Imibereho Dynamic Social Registry System on 29 February 2024, replacing the Ubudehe classification.
BMZ reports Imibereho targets households for the Vision Umurenge Programme and determines payments for Community-based Health Insurance.
BMZ reports data in Imibereho is validated through cross-checks with other government databases including the National ID Agency (NIDA).
